narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed FY26 revenue reached Rs 2,11,000 crore; reported FY26 revenue was Rs 2,10,973 crore.
Q1 FY27 management reported revenue of Rs 58,500 crore; actual reported Jun 2026 revenue was Rs 58,539 crore.
Management reported Q1 FY27 operating free cash flow over Rs 16,450 crore; FY26 annual FCF stood at Rs 76,683 crore.
De-leveraging narrative matches data as D/E reduced from 2.91 in Mar 2023 to 1.26 in Sep 2026.

bull: FY26 revenue expanded 21.96% to Rs 2,10,973 crore from Rs 1,72,985 crore in FY25.
Free cash flow surged 30% to Rs 76,683 crore in FY26 from Rs 58,990 crore in FY25.
D/E leverage ratio reduced steadily from 2.55 in Mar 2022 to 1.26 in Sep 2026.
bear: Annual PAT dropped from Rs 37,481 crore in FY25 to Rs 33,823 crore in FY26.
Dec 2025 PAT declined 47.3% YoY and Mar 2026 PAT declined 25.9% YoY.
Total borrowings remain high at Rs 1,99,432 crore as of Sep 2026.
watch: Data center capacity growth from 130 MW toward 1 GW target.
FY27 capex trajectory compared to FY26 annual capex.
Quarterly PAT growth recovery following FY26 net profit declines.
